chunks: Whoever swears an oath and then sees something better than it, let him do that which is better, and he will have an additional good deed.

key_terms.حَسَنَةٍ: a good deed or virtuous reward
key_terms.فَلْيَأْتِ: then let him do or carry out

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they swear an oath and later find a better course of action?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that if a person makes an oath and later realizes that a better course of action exists, he should pursue the better action. It emphasizes moral priority and indicates that choosing the better course brings additional reward.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4275 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever swears an oath and then sees something better than it, let him do that which is better, and he will have an additional good deed."
